messages.text: Behind me is the Spiders Mound.
Be careful, though! The Broodmother has made the summit home, and she's quite tenacious!

messages.context: Haymitch 数起山上的危险蜘蛛
messages.raw: §fBroodmother, Broodfather, Arachne... There are so many dangerous spiders around here.
messages.text: Broodmother, Broodfather, Arachne... There are so many dangerous spiders around here.
messages.gloss: 育母蜘蛛沿用本文件译名；Broodfather 译育父蜘蛛，Arachne 为角色专名。Wiki DOM 该行正文为 format-f 白色，和实测无颜色码版本兼容。
messages.zh: 育母蜘蛛、育父蜘蛛、Arachne……这附近的危险蜘蛛可真不少。

messages.context: Haymitch 吐槽蜘蛛巢穴会再生的沙砾
messages.raw: §fThe gravel on this island seems to magically reappear when you break it. I don't ask questions.
messages.text: The gravel on this island seems to magically reappear when you break it. I don't ask questions.
messages.zh: 这座岛的沙砾挖掉后好像又会自己冒出来。别问我，我也搞不懂。

messages.context: Haymitch 提醒雨天史莱姆和雷暴的危险
messages.raw: §fSlimes seem to spawn on the hills when it §brains§r. They're a bit more dangerous during a §6thunderstorm§r.
messages.text: Slimes seem to spawn on the hills when it rains. They're a bit more dangerous during a thunderstorm.
messages.zh: 下雨时山坡上似乎会冒出史莱姆。碰上雷暴，它们还会更危险。
